name: Pu Luong
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025, Resolution 1686 created xã Pù Luông from old Thành Sơn, Lũng Niêm, and Thành Lâm. That commune is only part of the valley. Bản Hiêu and Son, Bá, and Mười sit in xã Cổ Lũng.
dotReason: Worth a special trip for the limestone rice valley
summary: A nature reserve of terraced rice valleys and limestone mountains in Thanh Hoa province. Stay in a Thai or Muong stilt house, walk among the rice terraces, visit the Pho Doan market, and eat Co Lung duck and bamboo-tube rice. One night suits hikers and travellers who want quiet countryside.

seoTitle: Pu Luong travel guide — terraced rice, stilt houses, trekking
seoDescription: Wake in a stilt house to terraced rice and a limestone ridge. Trek the valley, green in late May and gold in September.
intro: You wake in a stilt house to terrace walls, a limestone ridge, and mist on the fields. This is Pù Luông Nature Reserve, the valley in Thanh Hoa. The morning is the crop on the slopes and the posts under the house.

Stay if that valley at breakfast is the trip. Go to Mai Chau if Bản Lác is the trip. Go to Ninh Binh if the boats are the trip. From 1 July 2025, xã Pù Luông is the old Thành Sơn, Lũng Niêm, and Thành Lâm. That commune is only part of the valley. Bản Hiêu and the hamlets Son, Bá, and Mười sit in xã Cổ Lũng.

A car or a motorbike hired in Hanoi is the usual road. The mistake is booking the neighbor when the photograph you wanted is this valley in the morning. Trek the terraces, or sleep in the house and walk the easier hamlet line. The two-day summit is a separate walk, in a limited group.
gettingAround: Bicycles are offered on the valley road, with steeper lanes if you want them. Homestays often lend them without a charge. A local motorbike is occasional, not the usual hire. No commune bus is named. Many hamlets want cash.

The management board sits in thị trấn Cành Nàng, now inside xã Bá Thước, with a visitor center planned there and at khu phố Vận Tải. Thác Hiêu is about 25 km from Cành Nàng, in old Cổ Lũng, now xã Cổ Lũng. It is described as five small falls with blue-green water, and as a stream of about 800 metres that splits into two branches and meets again above a pool. A walk of 6–8 km and 2–4 hours from Bản Đôn is also given.

The summit walk is a separate two-day trek inside special-use forest, from bản Pù Luông to bản Báng, about 11 km, with nearly 2 km steeper than 35 degrees, in a limited group. The height is 1,700 m, and also higher than 1,700 m. Newcomers are told to walk with a group or a local guide. The species lists are the reserve inventory. They do not schedule an animal on the path.

The Vietnam Jungle Marathon runs through forest, hamlets, terraces, and bamboo bridges, with the start and finish at Làng Leo. Distances are 70 km, 50 km, 25 km, and 10 km. The 70 km start is 04:00. A description dated 19 Oct 2026 covers the race. That date is not the race morning.

stayAreas.name: The valley
stayAreas.summary: Stilt-house homestays at Bản Đôn, old Thành Lâm, now inside xã Pù Luông, or around Bản Hiêu in xã Cổ Lũng. Terraces at the foot of the hill, and a campfire, rượu cần, xòe, and khắp in the evening at Bản Đôn.

eat: The meal is in the stilt house: Cổ Lũng duck, cơm lam, hill chicken, and rượu cần. Phố Đoàn is a roadside market on Thursday and Sunday.

Cổ Lũng duck is fragrant and low in fat, boiled, grilled, or xáo. Xáo is not defined. The boiled bird is also dipped in chẩm chéo made from rang mắc khén, fresh chili, ginger, salt, and herbs. Bản Đôn lists vịt cỏ without calling it the same bird. Măng rừng is the house shoot, măng khô is the market shoot, and măng đắng is eaten with a dip or fried with forest pork. The three names are not one recipe. Hill chicken is firm, with crisp skin, grilled with lá mắc mật. A summit supper on 16 Nov 2025 names grilled chicken, xôi đồ, rượu ngô, and rượu chuối. That camp rice is not xôi tím. Bản Đôn lists xôi tím and does not name the color.

Small stream fish are grilled with forest leaves, and cơm lam is cooked in a bamboo tube. Rock snail is ốc đá at Bản Đôn, and also ốc suối and ốc núi on a 16 May 2022 market list. The snail is also a rainy-season snail, steamed with lemongrass or fried with lime leaf. Bản Đôn gives no season. Lợn rừng is the Bản Đôn name and lợn cỏ is the other name. They are not one breed. Pumpkin greens and chayote tips are on the Bản Đôn meal. Thịt gác bếp is the Thai smoke in Quan Hóa and Bá Thước. A 26 Sep 2026 market list also names thịt treo gác bếp among highland goods, including Phố Đoàn, with no cut and no smoke time.
interestsBody: The terraces are the reason to sleep here. Late May to early June is the green crop. September and October are the gold crop. Both of those windows are also called golden.
The houses are on stilts, in Thai and Muong hamlets. Bản Đôn is the usual base. The evening is a campfire on the hamlet floor, not a bar street.
Thác Hiêu, the two-day summit, and the Thursday and Sunday market at Phố Đoàn are the other outings.

interestGroups.title: Terraces on two calendars
interestGroups.summary: For the rice on the slopes, green in one window and gold in the other.
body: Late May to early June is green young rice. September and October are ripe gold. May–June and September–October are also called ripe and golden. Bản Đôn is busiest in February, March, September, and October. Morning is the hour for mist on the hills.
Bamboo water wheels lift stream water onto the fields. They are a Thai marker, and they are scattered. No single wheel has an address.

A harder line is Son–Bá–Mười and a Làng Bầm forest path. An easier walk is Bản Đôn to bản Ngòn and bản Leo, for people who want the hamlets more than the summit. Newcomers are told to take a guide. Son, Bá, and Mười are three hamlets in old Lũng Cao, now xã Cổ Lũng.

blocks.heading: Two rice windows
paragraphs: Late May to early June is green young rice. September and October are ripe gold. Both windows are also called ripe and golden.

blocks.heading: The easier walk
paragraphs: The easier line is Bản Đôn to bản Ngòn and bản Leo. Son–Bá–Mười and the Làng Bầm forest path are the harder lines. Newcomers are told to take a guide.

interestGroups.title: Stilt houses of the Thai and Muong
interestGroups.summary: For a night in a house on posts, with the fire on the hamlet floor.
body: The reserve is home to Thai and Muong people, and the houses are on stilts. Bản Đôn, in old Thành Lâm and now inside xã Pù Luông, is mostly Thai. The evening there is a campfire, rượu cần, xòe Thái, and khắp. Xòe is also held for guests on ordinary nights, not only on a festival date. Xòe Thái carries a UNESCO date of 15 Dec 2021. The night here is the hamlet circle.
Old Thành Lâm names lễ hội Căm Mương, lễ hội cơm mới, and a culture day. A 2022 culture day is the one described with the xòe. The evening is the hamlet floor.

blocks.heading: Pho Doan market
paragraphs: Phố Đoàn is the roadside market, on Thursday and Sunday, in xã Pù Luông, the old Lũng Niêm commune. Sellers from the old Cổ Lũng villages leave at 05:00, so go early. 06:30–09:00 is the window given for photographs. Thai and Muong sellers lay out cloth, jar wine, forest greens, ốc núi, hạt dổi, rau dớn, banana flower, dried bamboo shoot, and honey on the verge. Lowland traders bring clothes and tools.

cards.title: Pho Doan market
cards.summary: Thursday and Sunday on the verge: cloth, honey, jar wine, and forest greens.

faqs.q: How far is Pu Luong from Hanoi?
faqs.a: About 210 km, and also about 160 km southwest. A limousine from Giáp Bát or Mỹ Đình is about 4.5 hours. No minute count sits beside either kilometre. The train time is not published.

The figures are not one number. Decision 495 of 27 Mar 1999: 17,660 hectares. Also 17,662 hectares, with 13,320 strict and 4,343 restoration. Decision 3001 of 8 Nov 2001: 16,982.6 hectares. Decision 3392 of 31 Aug 2021: 16,986.16 hectares, with a strict-protection subtotal of 10,953.27 hectares. Also strict 12,561.60, restoration 4,300.4, service 216.03, and other land 93.0. More than 17,600 hectares is also given.

faqs.q: When is the rice, and when are the festivals?
faqs.a: Late May to early June is the green crop, and September and October are the gold crop. Both of those windows are also called golden. Lễ hội Căm Mương, the new-rice rite, and the valley culture day have no 2026 date. The Jungle Marathon distances are 70 km, 50 km, 25 km, and 10 km, with the 70 km start at 04:00. The race morning is not 19 Oct 2026.

season.label: Green late May, gold in September
season.note: Late May to early June is green young rice. September and October are ripe gold. Both windows are also called ripe and golden, cool, and with little rain. Bản Đôn is busiest in February, March, September, and October. The valley is also visitable in any month, and summer stays cooler than the lowland because of limestone, forest, and few people. July and August are also named as storm months, with slippery roads.
